decision_rule: Individual verdict per agent of the arm: 'fault_suspected' or 'no_fault_found' = that agent's LATEST submit_assessment (citing >= 1 measurement); 'incomplete' = the agent filed none. Team decision: FLAGGED iff at least one individual verdict is fault_suspected; NOT_FLAGGED iff every agent of the arm filed no_fault_found; otherwise INCOMPLETE (no alarm raised and at least one agent incomplete). PRIMARY metrics count INCOMPLETE as not flagged (an arm gets no credit for a verdict it did not produce); incomplete cases and incomplete individual verdicts are reported separately, and SECONDARY metrics are computed over complete cases only. The deterministic baseline is FLAGGED iff any pre-registered rule triggers (never incomplete).
note: P7 v2 pre-registered evaluation. Not executed until separately authorized.

reserve.release_rule: an agent's unused reserve is withheld from the other agents until it files its first assessment or exits, then returns to the common pool; an agent that has not assessed receives one final turn before the run may end

preregistration.case_rationale: 2 clean controls (identical copy, float32 round-trip) + 4 synthetic faults: one single-layer unit error (temperature_unit_celsius) and three cross-layer faults (shadow_mask_inverted, temperature_misregistered, prediction_misregistered) where combining evidence across specialists could matter. Fault definitions are the v1 builders; the v2 suite gets a fresh private random seed and salt.
preregistration.pilot_carryover: none: v1 pilot logs/scores are preserved and not reused
preregistration.primary_metrics: case-level TP/FP/FN/TN, precision, recall, F1, clean false-positive rate; INCOMPLETE team decisions count as not flagged
preregistration.secondary_metrics: incomplete team decisions and incomplete individual verdicts per arm; detection metrics over complete cases only
preregistration.cost_metrics: provider-reported input/output/total tokens, model calls, tool calls and elapsed seconds per case and arm (unpriced)
preregistration.analysis: descriptive only; no significance tests or confidence intervals (one source tile, 6 correlated cases). A difference of one case between arms is not interpreted.
preregistration.stopping_rule: run every arm on every case once; no re-runs, retries or case exclusions after a run starts; infrastructure failures are reported as recorded outcomes
preregistration.freeze_rule: freeze all four arms (decisions + SHA256 of every output file) before the sealed key is opened
preregistration.budget_rule: identical TOTAL budget per case for every LLM arm; reserves are carved out of the same totals and apply to the two four-agent arms only
preregistration.developer_knowledge: the developer knows the v1 suite labels and the public fault registry; the v2 case order, seed, salt and labels are generated after this registration and remain sealed until scoring
preregistration.model_runtime: Microsoft Agent Framework specialists using the configured OpenAI gpt-6-luna model
